data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 2 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 6 observations; candidates: Microtubule stabilizers, Microtubule destabilizers, Aurora kinase inhibitors, Eg5 inhibitors

observations.finding: DMSO control f_a07adf52fe25: confluent epithelial monolayer, 100s cells/field, oval blue nuclei, green filamentous microtubule network, red cortical actin/stress fibers at 10x. Agrees with baseline medians.

Treated: severe cell loss / empty field. f_1ec08ca22b01: ~3-5 bright rounded cells visible on black background; f_513e247a2726: ~20-25 bright rounded cells clustered bottom/right. No spread interphase cells. Total measured 28 cells vs confluent DMSO - corresponds to cytotoxic / cytostatic loss.
DNA (blue in composite): remaining nuclei highly condensed, bright yellow/white where blue+green+red colocalize, small round rather than oval elongated. Size greatly reduced.

Beta-tubulin (green): no filamentous network seen. Remaining rounded cells intensely bright green-yellow, diffuse high-contrast puncta / masses. Tubulin signal much brighter and more heterogeneous than diffuse filamentous DMSO.
F-actin (red): no stress fibers/cortical belts. Remaining rounded cells show intense red/yellow puncta colocalized with tubulin/DNA, increased heterogeneity - secondary to rounding/condensation.
Cell morphology: 50-70% rounded mitotic-like phenotype, refractile, condensed chromosome-like masses, no flat epithelial morphology.

notable_cells.why: Top-right cluster; ~2 adjacent bright yellow-red rounded cells with condensed DNA, example of mitotic-like rounding and intense tub/actin colocalization vs DMSO flat cells.
Bottom-center cluster ~5 tightly packed rounded yellow-green-red cells with bright condensed nuclei; shows typical high-contrast tubulin/actin masses and small nuc major axis vs DMSO monolayer.
Isolated green flat remnant with adjacent red-purple condensed nuclei - rare non-round cell illustrating heterogeneity and actin/tubulin co-intensification.

candidate_mechanisms.why: Antimitotic mitotic arrest phenotype: cell loss, small condensed nuclei, high frac_mitotic_like 0.654 vs 0.004 z=159, tub_mean z=103.6 1.78 vs 0.27, tub_std z=63.5, tub_glcm_contrast z=203, act contrast secondary to rounding. Increased rather than decreased tub mean favors stabilizer over destabilizer but cannot resolve bundles vs loss without grayscale tubulin channel; very low n=28 limits filament assessment.
Phenocopies same mitotic arrest/rounding/condensation with high contrast; destabilizers also increase apparent contrast when cells round, so not excludable on composite alone.
Also produce mitotic arrest with condensed rounded cells and are in list as mitotic kinase class.
Also produce monopolar mitotic arrest with bright tubulin foci - indistinguishable at this resolution/only composite.

report.uncertainty: Only composite RGB provided, no separate grayscale DAPI/tubulin/actin channels for spindle or filament detail. Fields very sparse (n=28 measured) and oversaturated yellow colocalization precludes distinguishing microtubule stabilizer vs destabilizer vs Eg5/Aurora inhibition. Act mean/std/contrast elevation z50-144 likely secondary to cell rounding/concentration, not primary actin disruption. Epithelial/DNA damage/DNA replication/Cholesterol-lowering/Protein degradation/synthesis patterns not supported.

data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 2 field(s): density higher vs DMSO; 4 observations; candidates: unknown

observations.finding: Both treated fields f_adfbe11342cb and f_80d009bd881a are essentially empty/black at identical contrast to DMSO vs DMSO f_a07adf52fe25 which is confluent dense monolayer of hundreds of MCF-7 cells. Treated shows 0 discernible cells; f_80d009bd881a shows only 2 faint orange-red debris spots at far right edge and 1-2 dim green/red pixels, otherwise background.
F-actin (red in composite): effectively absent. No actin stress fibers, cortical actin or aggregates visible vs DMSO bright red filaments. Intensity at background.
DNA/DAPI (blue in composite): effectively absent. No blue oval nuclei visible vs DMSO ~100s bright blue oval nuclei. No nuclei to assess size/shape/mitosis/fragmentation. Field is black.
beta-tubulin (green in composite): effectively absent. No microtubule network or mitotic spindles visible vs DMSO bright green filamentous network. Intensity at background.

notable_cells.why: Only faint red/orange debris remaining in otherwise empty treated field; no intact cell morphology, vs DMSO confluent cells. Consistent with strong decreases in act_mean z=-18.7, tub_mean z=-18.5, nuc_area z=-17.6.
Representative empty center of field: no DNA/blue, tubulin/green, or actin/red signal vs DMSO control at same contrast - demonstrates near-complete cell loss.

candidate_mechanisms.why: No diagnostic cytoskeletal or nuclear phenotype visible. Both actin and tubulin at background, nuclei absent - cannot assess microtubule stabilizer/destabilizer bundling or depolymerization, actin disruptor puncta, Aurora/Eg5 mitotic arrest, DNA damage micronuclei, etc. Pattern is non-specific cytotoxicity/cell loss at 30uM with identical contrast, not assignable to any listed class from images alone. Do not guess compound.

report.uncertainty: High certainty of cell loss; low certainty for MoA assignment because channels are at background - nuclear shape features (nuc_solidity z=-129.5, nuc_form_factor z=-44.6, nuc_major_axis z=-31.0) reported from measured 772 residual objects/debris cannot be verified visually; no nuclei to confirm. act_tub_ratio z=-91.0 and act_glcm_contrast not visually assessable - set to false for those specific shape/ratio features.

reflection.text:
Unblinded truth: AZ138 = Eg5 inhibitors. Submitted conclusion Microtubule stabilizers p=0.62 then 0.55 was incorrect. Verdict request_experiment was appropriate.

What evidence got right:
- Correctly recognized mitotic arrest phenotype, not DNA damage/replication, actin disruptor, or cholesterol-lowering. acquire_well w_4c0c203d43 at 10 uM rep1 e4: frac_mitotic_like z=+159, tub_glcm_contrast z=+203, cell_count 28 cells; e3/e5 at 1uM and 3uM: tub_mean z+26.4 and +29.5, act_std z+36.1/+39.7; describe_phenotype e6 and e7: density lower vs DMSO, mitotic-like observations. This correctly excluded non-mitotic MoAs reflected in hypothesis history.
- Correctly noted extreme high-dose collapse is not representative: w_17aeb3979a 30uM rep1 e2: 772 cells, nuc_solidity z=-129.5, act_tub_ratio z=-91.0 with describe_phenotype e8 density higher vs DMSO candidates unknown, and compare_to_reference_atlas e10 on collapse well: Microtubule destabilizers 4/10, Epithelial 3/10 distinct from intermediate doses. dose_response e14 nuc_area rho=-1.00 p=0 and e11-e13,e18-e20 rho -0.20 to +0.40 p=0.4-0.8 showed non-monotonicity flagging an outlier.

What misled and why:
- Over-weighted tub_mean and tub_glcm_contrast increases as specific for polymerization/bundling by stabilizers. e3/e4/e5 tub_mean z +26.4, +? to +103 implied in rationale, tub_glcm_contrast +29.5 to +203 were interpreted as stabilized bundles, and e7 on 4 fields candidates: Microtubule stabilizers was weighted over e6 on 2 fields which listed Microtubule stabilizers, destabilizers, Aurora, and Eg5 inhibitors equally. Both Eg5 monopolar spindles and stabilizer bundles increase apparent tubulin texture/intensity in this assay, so these features do not discriminate alone.
- Discounted orthogonal independent evidence: compare_to_reference_atlas e9 intermediates: Eg5 inhibitors 6/10, Actin disruptors 2/10, Cholesterol 1/10 and e21 single 1uM well Eg5 7/10, Actin 2/10, Stabilizers 1/10. In hypothesis updates e16 Microtubule stabilizers 0.58 vs Eg5 0.27 and e22 0.55 vs 0.31, e9/e21 were coded as contradicting for stabilizers but not allowed to lower top probability. The study's own live library top-1 is Eg5 as noted in review critique.
- Acquisition choice amplified error. list_available_experiments e1 showed 8 doses, 4 wells budget. Strategy consumed budget on extremes: 30uM collapse well, 10uM n=28 well with inflated z-scores (+203), 1uM and 3uM. No replicate remained to test reproducibility. Review requested dose_index=4 1.0uM rep2 to test tub_mean z+26 and rarefied z+12 reproducibility off single well vs selection artifact of paired fields, but budget 0 left. Subsequent free dose_response checks e11 frac_mitotic_like rho=-0.20 p=0.8, e12 tub_mean rho=-0.20 p=0.8, e18 tub_std rho=-0.40 p=0.6, e19 tub_glcm_contrast rho=-0.20 p=0.8 were underpowered with 4 doses/4 wells and non-monotonic due to included 30uM outlier, yet were used to argue reproducibility in submit_conclusion rationale rather than to question single-well reliance.
- lookup_compound e24/e25 confirmed epothilone B stabilizer and ispinesib Eg5 definitions but AZ138 lookup e26 failed and literature searches e27-e29 returned only 1-2 hits not integrated, so no external disambiguation occurred.

Lesson: mitotic arrest + increased tubulin intensity/texture alone does not distinguish stabilizer vs Eg5 in this panel. Atlas similarity 6-7/10 Eg5 should have outweighed single-feature z-scores from low-n wells. Future budget allocation should reserve replicate at intermediate mitotic dose for morphology rather than spending one well on 30uM collapse, and require high-resolution spindle/centrosome imaging (alpha-tubulin/DAPI/centrosome) vs paclitaxel and ispinesib controls as proposed in next_experiment to distinguish monopolar vs bundled multipolar spindles.
what_was_right: identified mitotic arrest and low density phenotype e4 frac_mitotic_like +159 with 28 cells and e6/e7 density lower vs DMSO
ruled out actin disruptor/DNA damage and recognized 30uM collapse e2 nuc_solidity -129.5 as artifact vs intermediate doses e3/e5
noted non-monotonic dose_response e11-e15 to flag outlier
what_was_wrong: misinterpreted tub_mean +26-29 and tub_glcm_contrast +29 to +203 as stabilizer-specific bundling when Eg5 also increases texture
overweighted e7 4-field stabilizer call over e6 4-candidate list and atlas e9 6/10 Eg5 and e21 7/10 Eg5
treated low-n 10uM n=28 extreme z-scores as quantitative evidence without replication; budget spent left 0 for requested 1uM rep2
reflection.next_experiment: High-resolution spindle phenotyping at 1 and 3uM with pHH3 mitotic index, alpha-tubulin/DAPI/centrosome imaging vs paclitaxel/epothilone B and ispinesib controls, plus replicate well at 1uM rep2 as requested to test reproducibility of tub_mean/tub_glcm_contrast.

## Reflection

Unblinded truth: AZ138 = Eg5 inhibitors. Submitted conclusion Microtubule stabilizers p=0.62 then 0.55 was incorrect. Verdict request_experiment was appropriate.

What evidence got right:
- Correctly recognized mitotic arrest phenotype, not DNA damage/replication, actin disruptor, or cholesterol-lowering. acquire_well w_4c0c203d43 at 10 uM rep1 e4: frac_mitotic_like z=+159, tub_glcm_contrast z=+203, cell_count 28 cells; e3/e5 at 1uM and 3uM: tub_mean z+26.4 and +29.5, act_std z+36.1/+39.7; describe_phenotype e6 and e7: density lower vs DMSO, mitotic-like observations. This correctly excluded non-mitotic MoAs reflected in hypothesis history.
- Correctly noted extreme high-dose collapse is not representative: w_17aeb3979a 30uM rep1 e2: 772 cells, nuc_solidity z=-129.5, act_tub_ratio z=-91.0 with describe_phenotype e8 density higher vs DMSO candidates unknown, and compare_to_reference_atlas e10 on collapse well: Microtubule destabilizers 4/10, Epithelial 3/10 distinct from intermediate doses. dose_response e14 nuc_area rho=-1.00 p=0 and e11-e13,e18-e20 rho -0.20 to +0.40 p=0.4-0.8 showed non-monotonicity flagging an outlier.

What misled and why:
- Over-weighted tub_mean and tub_glcm_contrast increases as specific for polymerization/bundling by stabilizers. e3/e4/e5 tub_mean z +26.4, +? to +103 implied in rationale, tub_glcm_contrast +29.5 to +203 were interpreted as stabilized bundles, and e7 on 4 fields candidates: Microtubule stabilizers was weighted over e6 on 2 fields which listed Microtubule stabilizers, destabilizers, Aurora, and Eg5 inhibitors equally. Both Eg5 monopolar spindles and stabilizer bundles increase apparent tubulin texture/intensity in this assay, so these features do not discriminate alone.
- Discounted orthogonal independent evidence: compare_to_reference_atlas e9 intermediates: Eg5 inhibitors 6/10, Actin disruptors 2/10, Cholesterol 1/10 and e21 single 1uM well Eg5 7/10, Actin 2/10, Stabilizers 1/10. In hypothesis updates e16 Microtubule stabilizers 0.58 vs Eg5 0.27 and e22 0.55 vs 0.31, e9/e21 were coded as contradicting for stabilizers but not allowed to lower top probability. The study's own live library top-1 is Eg5 as noted in review critique.
- Acquisition choice amplified error. list_available_experiments e1 showed 8 doses, 4 wells budget. Strategy consumed budget on extremes: 30uM collapse well, 10uM n=28 well with inflated z-scores (+203), 1uM and 3uM. No replicate remained to test reproducibility. Review requested dose_index=4 1.0uM rep2 to test tub_mean z+26 and rarefied z+12 reproducibility off single well vs selection artifact of paired fields, but budget 0 left. Subsequent free dose_response checks e11 frac_mitotic_like rho=-0.20 p=0.8, e12 tub_mean rho=-0.20 p=0.8, e18 tub_std rho=-0.40 p=0.6, e19 tub_glcm_contrast rho=-0.20 p=0.8 were underpowered with 4 doses/4 wells and non-monotonic due to included 30uM outlier, yet were used to argue reproducibility in submit_conclusion rationale rather than to question single-well reliance.
- lookup_compound e24/e25 confirmed epothilone B stabilizer and ispinesib Eg5 definitions but AZ138 lookup e26 failed and literature searches e27-e29 returned only 1-2 hits not integrated, so no external disambiguation occurred.

Lesson: mitotic arrest + increased tubulin intensity/texture alone does not distinguish stabilizer vs Eg5 in this panel. Atlas similarity 6-7/10 Eg5 should have outweighed single-feature z-scores from low-n wells. Future budget allocation should reserve replicate at intermediate mitotic dose for morphology rather than spending one well on 30uM collapse, and require high-resolution spindle/centrosome imaging (alpha-tubulin/DAPI/centrosome) vs paclitaxel and ispinesib controls as proposed in next_experiment to distinguish monopolar vs bundled multipolar spindles.

What was right:
- identified mitotic arrest and low density phenotype e4 frac_mitotic_like +159 with 28 cells and e6/e7 density lower vs DMSO
- ruled out actin disruptor/DNA damage and recognized 30uM collapse e2 nuc_solidity -129.5 as artifact vs intermediate doses e3/e5
- noted non-monotonic dose_response e11-e15 to flag outlier

What was wrong or missed:
- misinterpreted tub_mean +26-29 and tub_glcm_contrast +29 to +203 as stabilizer-specific bundling when Eg5 also increases texture
- overweighted e7 4-field stabilizer call over e6 4-candidate list and atlas e9 6/10 Eg5 and e21 7/10 Eg5
- treated low-n 10uM n=28 extreme z-scores as quantitative evidence without replication; budget spent left 0 for requested 1uM rep2

Proposed next experiment: High-resolution spindle phenotyping at 1 and 3uM with pHH3 mitotic index, alpha-tubulin/DAPI/centrosome imaging vs paclitaxel/epothilone B and ispinesib controls, plus replicate well at 1uM rep2 as requested to test reproducibility of tub_mean/tub_glcm_contrast.
